opening.argument: The promotional material links a concrete reward claim to a viewer action: viewers are told to register on Blofin “now” for “Cash Bonuses,” using the supplied partner link. The same description directs viewers toward a premium signal group promising a community focused on “real profitability.” That creates a solicitation pathway in which viewers are encouraged to follow an external destination and register in connection with a financial benefit. The disclaimer does not remove that practical reward-action linkage; it simply says the video is informational and not financial advice.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The market-analysis framing does not answer the separate solicitation. Discussing Ethereum, ETF flows, or support levels does not establish that the linked registration offer is harmless. The defense itself identifies a premium signal group and a Blofin link, while the description expressly couples registration with cash bonuses. A disclaimer cannot change what viewers are being directed to do or the benefit presented alongside that action.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted registration language does not promise that every viewer will receive money, nor does it describe a hidden withdrawal or verification scheme. It identifies cash bonuses offered by the linked platform and separately discloses the creator’s fee relationship: “I am partnered with Blofin and get a % of the fees you pay.” The video’s substantive discussion remains conditional market commentary, including that a breakdown is only an expectation.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: an external premium group, Discord and Telegram destinations, a profitability-oriented pitch, an instruction to register “now,” and “Cash Bonuses” attached to that registration. The channel also places a scam warning beside a call to use its Telegram and Discord communities, showing that impersonation and platform-directed contact are part of the surrounding audience funnel. Even without a guaranteed return, this combination makes the reward solicitation unusually easy to follow while shifting viewers toward outside services.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling these merely commercial promotions understates the combined signals. The description does not just mention a sponsor; it urges immediate registration for cash bonuses and separately routes viewers to premium signals centered on profitability. The on-screen scam warning may sound protective, but it simultaneously directs viewers toward free Telegram and Discord communities, so it does not eliminate the risk created by the external-contact funnel.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: External links and crypto-related services are not, by themselves, evidence of a scam. The description discloses the affiliate relationship rather than concealing it, and the frame’s warning tells viewers to be careful about scams and impersonators. The cited material does not show that the bonuses are fake, that access requires a deposit, or that the community uses impersonators.

opening.argument: The apparent analysis functions as promotional lead generation because the branded presentation places “PREMIUM + SIGNALS + TRADING GUIDE” above the market charts, while the description offers a premium group and directs viewers to register with a named trading platform. The Ethereum discussion therefore supplies a credibility context for steering viewers toward profitability-focused services and a bonus-linked registration. Its analytical vocabulary does not erase the commercial role of the surrounding calls to action.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense focuses on what the charts discuss, but the issue is how that discussion is packaged. The branded frame explicitly combines premium signals and a trading guide with “links down,” and the description pairs profitability-focused mentorship with an immediate bonus-linked registration. That surrounding structure supports reading the analysis as a route into promoted participation, rather than as a self-contained news item.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The frame’s branding shows promotion, but promotion alone does not establish the specific low-barrier reward mechanism required here. The cited text does not say viewers must pay for the premium group, deposit funds, or buy an asset to receive a return. The analytical content also includes concrete discussion of ETF flows, support, and conditional price scenarios, while the description openly labels the material educational.
